title: Narrow string substring comparison
summary: Recover 0x422be0 as a const thiscall member: validate position, clamp count to remaining length, choose inline/heap storage by capacity, compare unsigned bytes and break equal-prefix ties by length. No writes on valid paths. Original invalid position imports std::_Xout_of_range with invalid string position; the port exposes this as a nonreturning integration dependency.
test_description: Differential original thiscall tests for capacities 0/15/16/31/UINT_MAX, inline lengths 0..15 and heap lengths 0..64, all valid positions, count boundaries including UINT_MAX, right lengths 0..65, equal prefixes and injected high-bit mismatches, unaligned buffers, embedded NUL, aliasing, null right with zero count, and all 65536 single-byte pairs. Check exact -1/0/+1 and unchanged full 24-byte object, backing buffer, and comparison buffer after each original and recovered call.
known_limits: Invalid-position exception dispatch/unwind cannot be exercised by this freestanding harness. The required nonreturning narrow_out_of_range port hook must implement the original CRT out-of-range semantics; the test-only definition is unreachable on tested paths.
Valid readable buffers and coherent original 32-bit string objects required; races and invalid pointers are outside scope.
Behavioral source recovery only; no matching-byte claim. ABI layout asserted for i386/MSVC2013; a 64-bit port must account for pointer layout changes.
